BrokenUiSection.heading: Try to change the
BrokenUiSection.sub: Four controls. Each works. None should exist. Your task: touch each one and feel the user's pain.

paywall.modalBody: Volume above 50% is a premium feature. Listen without limits for just $4.99/mo.

BrokenUiSection.ctaSub: Each of these patterns exists in real apps.
BrokenUiSection.ctaStrong: QA catches them before users do.

paint.title: Paint the Volume
paint.hint: You must "paint" the bar. The more surface you cover, the louder. Precision? Unknown.

pump.title: Pressure Pump
pump.hint: Volume is pressure. Stop pumping — it starts leaking. Welcome to active listening.

paywall.title: Premium Volume
paywall.hint: First 50% is free. The rest requires a subscription. Decibel monetization.

catapult.title: Audio Catapult
catapult.hint: Charge, release, pray. Force depends on charge time. Ball landing = new volume.
